name: m0.1-golden-partner-places
input: I want an app where my partner and I can save places we want to visit.

expected.goal: Keep a shared list of places two people want to visit.

persistence.reason: The request explicitly describes saving or retaining information across uses.

assumptions.reason: The request describes persistent items used by more than one person, which maps cleanly to a shared-list product shape.
These are the smallest reversible lifecycle actions that make the inferred product shape usable.
Place and travel lists are commonly used away from a desk, and mobile-first presentation is reversible.
A known small group is safest as invite-only by default. This preserves privacy and can be relaxed later.
